description: Source code for HCISocket class and related Bluetooth management functionalities, including Bluetooth advertising, inquiry, scanning, device management, and management socket communication.

classes.name: HCISocket
classes.description: Class managing Bluetooth HCI socket communication, including advertising, inquiry, scanning, device management, and event handling.

classes.name: EIR
classes.description: Class for processing Extended Inquiry Response data, extracting device name, class, and UUIDs.

classes.name: ManagementType
classes.description: Template class for handling management commands with serialization, deserialization, and response processing.

classes.name: ManagementFixedType
classes.description: Template class for fixed-size management command structures.

classes.name: ManagementListType
classes.description: Template class for management commands involving lists of items, such as link keys or UUIDs.

methods.name: Advertising
methods.description: Enables or disables Bluetooth advertising with specified mode.

methods.name: Inquiry
methods.description: Performs a Bluetooth device inquiry for a specified duration and mode.

methods.name: Scan
methods.description: Starts Bluetooth scanning with specified parameters.

methods.name: Discovery
methods.description: Enables or disables Bluetooth device discovery mode.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Handles socket state changes and sets Bluetooth event filters.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes incoming HCI event data and updates internal state.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Virtual methods for updating internal state based on various Bluetooth events.
